headline: Nəsimi district features high transport accessibility and above average property prices

tags.reason: The transport index reaches 77 compared to the median of 55.5, supported by 4 metro stations.
New apartment prices stand at 2,660 AZN/m2 against the city median of 2,295 AZN/m2.

summary: Nəsimi has a population density of 21,970 residents per km2 compared to the Baku median of 2,890.5. The transport index is 77 (median 55.5), backed by 145 bus stops and 71 bus routes. The infrastructure index reaches 96 (median 49) with 100% paved roads among mapped streets. However, the affordability index is 29 (median 50), with old apartments costing 2,385 AZN/m2.
strengths: High share of paved surfaces among recorded streets (100% paved roads; median 83.1%)
Strong public transport network with 4 metro stations (transport index 77; median 55.5)
Above average concentration of dining options (14.29 food places per 10k; median 11.37)
weaknesses: Lower housing affordability compared to city benchmarks (affordability index 29; median 50)
Lower school density relative to population (2.73 schools per 10k; median 3.43)
Fewer grocery stores per capita (6.55 grocery stores per 10k; median 13.41)
best_for: Buyers seeking central urban connectivity via metro and bus networks
Residents prioritising paved road infrastructure and medical facilities
watch_out: 34.7% of road surfaces have unknown mapping status in OpenStreetMap
Land pricing of 50,000 AZN/sot represents mock demo data
confidence_note: OpenStreetMap data coverage for Nəsimi is high and per capita indicators are reliable, but land prices are mock demo values.
